closed_findings.closure: Rejects .. path components before reading any canonical dependency; fixture proves the outside file is not read.
closed_findings.finding: Canonical dependency traversal could pass lexical root containment.

closed_findings.closure: Reads at most maximum+1 bytes and verifies the bound and expected SHA; fixture intercepts the requested read size.
closed_findings.finding: File growth after stat could cause an unlimited read allocation.

closed_findings.closure: Requires finite positive started and completed clocks with started<=completed, preserving sampled values; reversed, nonfinite, zero and negative cases reject.
closed_findings.finding: A reversed verification interval could be accepted after wall-clock rollback.

closed_findings.closure: Bounded post-sync readback must match exact serialized bytes and SHA before success output; corruption and sync failures retain unaccepted evidence without success.
closed_findings.finding: Persisted output identity was inferred from successful write/fsync.

coverage: Four isolated synthetic registry/source closures and complete embedded copy inventory with canonical dependencies.
Copy status and exact scan/compile/source flags; report/copy/spec/member/dependency/registry/source hashes and copied sizes.
Exact selected-evidence name/hash identity, path traversal, separators, case collision, and mocked Windows reparse rejection.
Recursive exact-false authority values, including full assembly against an altered synthetic registry.
Source mutations after their first read are caught by final rechecks for each input category.
Exclusive output creation preserves existing and concurrently created files; sync/readback failure emits no success and leaves the orphan for inspection.

initial_dated_evidence.scope: Dated intermediate test evidence only. No exact initial helper-source hash is claimed or reconstructed; final acceptance binds only the actual final source above.

limits: The actual assembler was exercised only with synthetic temporary roots, toy registries and fixtures; no real project/vault output, credentials, broker, model, process or rescoring action occurred.
Expected copy/spec/report hashes and the four production registry pins remain caller-reviewed trust inputs; this verifier does not replace the curator credential scan or source-export verification.
Path checks assume a trusted local root. They are not an atomic filesystem transaction against an adversarial directory-renaming actor between OS operations.
Two-pass rechecks catch retained changes during verification; the result is a dated verification interval, not a simultaneous live operational snapshot.

completed_epoch records verification completion before output persistence; successful return additionally requires exact post-fsync readback. No directory-crash-durability or vault-publication claim is made.
source_owner_edits: Root changed the new external helper; reviewer changed only the isolated test/evidence files.
